answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 884 Country: India Title: My fmaly is searching girl for my marriage, I am engineer in Oman, so please suggest me what qualities I have to look in girl for marriage, can I find girl in Deoband madarsa, haaafizah, or alimah. How can I proceed? Question: My fmaly is searching girl for my marriage, I am engineer in Oman, so please suggest me what qualities I have to look in girl for marriage, can I find girl in Deoband madarsa, haaafizah, or alimah. How can I proceed? Answer ID: 884 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 322=322/L) For marriage, a pious and religious girl should be looked for. It is in stated in Hadith that woman is married for 4 reasons; nobility, wealth, beauty, religiousness. But, you should marry a pious girl. (Muttafaq Alaih: Mishkat page 268) The girl should be virgin, and younger than the husband or equal to him in age. Also, she should be better than the husband in morality, etiquettes, piety and beauty: و کونھا دونہ سنا و حسبا و عزا و مالا وفوقہ خلقا و ادبا وورعا وزاد فی البحر ونکاح البکر احسن للحدیث: علیکم بالابکار فانھن اعذب افواھا و انقی ارحاما و ارضی بالیسر اخرجہ ابن ماجة والبیھقی (الدر المختار مع الرد: 4/67،68) Sorry, there is no arrangement for girls? education in Darul Uloom Deoband. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
